capabilities: View PDFs with zoom, rotation, search, dark pages and per-file position memory
Highlight text in four colors across lines, columns and pages
Attach Markdown notes to highlights or page points and browse them in an annotations panel
Copy Obsidian links to pages, selections, highlights and notes that reopen penDF at that spot
Handwrite with Apple Pencil using pen, highlighter and stroke eraser
disambiguation: Not a handwriting or drawing plugin; it is a full PDF viewer that also supports Apple Pencil annotation.
extras: Not in the community plugin list yet; installs via BRAT or by copying release files manually. Sidecar .pendf.json files need 'Sync all other types' enabled for Obsidian Sync users. iPad behaviour is listed as pending device verification.
intentEvidence: It does not use, detect or patch Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer or any other plugin
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer offers little annotation support, which is a particular pain on iPad.

relations.evidence: it bundles its own copy of PDF.js and uses only Obsidian's public API

summary: Standalone iPad-first PDF viewer and annotator that bundles its own PDF.js and stores highlights, notes, bookmarks and handwriting in JSON sidecars.
